svg.text: UML component diagram. Fill colour is the component's role; connector notation is defined in the legend.
«subsystem» Test equipment — never in the release APK
«artifact» configuration & descriptors — outside the role groups
per receive, length reset each call
last warning, last state by seq,
returns the Display Area to Idle
Display Area, button areas, status bar;
God View — ego and B solid, ghost C
dashed with risk glow and [V2X] badge
DEV_INJECT broadcast onto the repository's flow;
debug source set — ships inside the debug APK
«use» dependency — the source needs the target
realization — the source implements the interface
«node» — an ECU boundary enclosing its components
provided ball meets required socket — assembly
